subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main repro of the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection supports the reporter's hypothesis, but changing global session-store behavior is compatibility-sensitive and the issue already has a live-repro gate.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage if it matches the source path.

options.title: Queue source-level fix now
options.body: Accept the source evidence and let a repair PR attempt a focused fix plus tests before live proof.

options.title: Fold into broader session routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open but defer implementation until adjacent global-session and DM-scope routing work is handled together.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Reproduce the WSL2 or Docker global-scope heartbeat case on current main, then queue a narrow fix with regression coverage if it matches the source path.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current blame owner for the relevant routing helpers and the clearest recent history contact for the global-session path.
